halvor_bwmine_0.m: Here we meet again. I'm surprised to see you this far from Crossglen!

halvor_bwmine_1.m: Well, I'm still looking for 5 good rat tails. Would you help me now?
r: Alright, I hope there are rats around here, and that they have tails good enough for you.
OK, but you'd better like them this time.
I don't feel like doing this now. Sorry.

halvor_bwmine_10.m: Hmm ... this one is nice! However, the other three won't do.

r: No way! I'm tired of your errands.
More work means more money! I'll be back.
I have these with me. Take them.

halvor_bwmine_13.m: Thanks. I'll be right here when you return.

halvor_bwmine_15.m: Thanks, but it's still not what I am looking for. Anyway, work must be rewarded. Take this gold.

halvor_bwmine_16.m: Hello again. Have you found some soft animal hair?
r: I think so. Here's what I found.

halvor_bwmine_17.m: Are you sure? Won't you help me find the softest animal hair?

halvor_bwmine_2.m: Great. I'll wait for you here.

halvor_bwmine_3.m: Have you found more rat tails?

halvor_bwmine_4.m: Perfect! I can't believe you found such good rat tails. Take this.

halvor_bwmine_5.m: Next on my list is some animal hair. It has to be soft hair though. I think 4 handfuls should do. Would you find them for me?
r: I guess I have no choice...
I already have them right here. Take them.

halvor_bwmine_6.m: Thanks a lot. I'll wait for you here.

halvor_bwmine_7.m: Hello again. Would you agree to get me 4 handfuls of animal hair now?
r: I guess I have no choice...
I already have them right here. Take them.

halvor_bwmine_8.m: Have you found the animal hair I asked for?

halvor_bwmine_9.m: Good. Take this gold and let me see them.

halvor_bwmine_leaving.m: Too bad. Thanks for helping me this far anyway.

halvor_chwood_0.m: The world is such a small place. We keep meeting in the most unusual places.

halvor_chwood_1.m: I found a bone that's long enough by myself since we last met. I just need another one. Could you try to find it for me?
r: Only one long bone? I'm on it!

halvor_chwood_10.m: I can't believe it! You really found them! Take this gold. It's all I have left.

halvor_chwood_11.m: I have finally gathered all the items I need! Kayla will be so thrilled.

halvor_chwood_12.m: Yes. She's a dear friend of mine. She lives in Stoutford.

halvor_chwood_13.m: She makes clothes and boots, and asked me to get her some of the finest items in the world for her work.

halvor_chwood_14.m: You should definitely pay her a visit when you are in Stoutford. I have to go now. Thank you for your help.
r: Glad to help. See you later.

halvor_chwood_2.m: So, would you bring me a bone now? A long one though!
r: Only one long bone? I'm on it!

halvor_chwood_3.m: Thank you. I'll wait for you here.

halvor_chwood_4.m: Have you found a long bone?

halvor_chwood_5.m: Awesome! Exactly what I was looking for.

halvor_chwood_6.m: Now, I just need one last thing. I heard about some nasty snakes, called the venomscale.

halvor_chwood_7.m: I'm really interested in their scales. Could you get me 10 of them?
r: I hope this really is the last thing you need.

halvor_chwood_8.m: Thank you. I'll wait here until you return.

halvor_chwood_9.m: Have you found the venomscale scales?

halvor_crossglen_0.m: Hello young fellow. Would you be so kind as to help a wandering traveller?
r: No. I don't have the time.
Why not. What do you need?

halvor_crossglen_1.m: I'd like to surprise a friend back home, when I return from my travels. I would need 5 insect wings. Could you bring them to me?
r: Sounds boring ... but I'll do it.
I have these with me. Take them.

halvor_crossglen_10.m: I'll wait for you here, as usual.

halvor_crossglen_12.m: Please ... I really need 5 rat tails.
r: OK ... but it's the last time!
No. No no no ... leave me alone.

halvor_crossglen_2.m: Thank you. I'll wait for you here.

halvor_crossglen_3.m: Have you found the 5 insect wings I need?
r: No, not yet. I'll be back.

halvor_crossglen_4.m: Great! Here, take this gold as a reward. Now I need some rat tails. Will you find them for me?
r: I have other things to do right now.

halvor_crossglen_5.m: Thank you. Bring me 5 of them. I'll wait for you here.
r: I hope this is worth it...
I already possess 5 rat tails. You can take them.

halvor_crossglen_6.m: Well. Would you agree to bring me some rat tails now?
r: I have other things to do right now.

halvor_crossglen_9.m: Hmm ... they're not as good as I hoped. Can you get me 5 more?
r: Not good enough for you? I'm tired of dealing with you.
As you wish. See you soon.
Well, I do have these 5 other rat tails here.

halvor_crossglen_leaving.m: OK. I'll go look somewhere else. Goodbye.

halvor_mlake_0.m: Hey! Long time no see. I'm happy to see a familiar face.

halvor_mlake_1.m: Travelling this far has exhausted me, and I'm running short of supplies. I'm glad I managed to reach this seemingly safe spot, but I don't think I can go further.

halvor_mlake_10.m: Did you change your mind? Care to help me find a pair of bones? Remember that they must be long ones though.
r: Sure! It's not like I have more important things to do.
I guess I can remember to look for bones if I have some spare time.
Let me check ... I do have two bones here with me. Take them.

halvor_mlake_11.m: Thanks. I will be here when you return.

halvor_mlake_12.m: Did you find some bones? I'm only interested in long ones though.

halvor_mlake_13.m: Nope. That won't work. Could you find some longer ones?
r: No. I don't think I can.

halvor_mlake_14.m: Thank you. You'll find me here when you return.

r: Yeah ... bones are too heavy to carry.

halvor_mlake_2.m: I could really use some healing. Do you happen to have a potion to spare?
r: Here, take this minor potion of health.
Here, take this minor vial of health.
Here, take this regular potion of health.
Here, take this major potion of health.
Here, take this major flask of health.
Here, take this Lodar's bonemeal potion.
Here, take this Lodar's potion of health.

halvor_mlake_3.m: That's too bad. I will rest here until someone can heal me. If I can wait that long...

halvor_mlake_4_lodar.m: I'm feeling ... strange ... I'm feeling ... great! That was incredible. I never had such a potion. Take this hat I found on my way here.

halvor_mlake_4_regular.m: Thank you. I'm feeling way better already.

halvor_mlake_4_strong.m: Wow. That was some serious healing potion.

halvor_mlake_4_weak.m: Thank you. I'm feeling a little better now. With some rest, I'll be able to continue my travels soon.

halvor_mlake_5.m: Back to business. I found awesome items on my way here, but I'm still looking for 3 handfuls of soft animal hair. Would you help me?
r: I don't feel like doing it right now.
I happen to have some here. Take them.

halvor_mlake_7.m: Have you found really soft animal hair?
r: I think I do. Look at these.

halvor_mlake_8.m: Beautiful! They're even better than what I expected. I love the shade too. You really deserve a reward, plus a bonus for healing me. Take it. No need to thank me.

halvor_mlake_9.m: I'm getting closer to the end of my list. I now have to find some bones. They must be long ones though. Would you look for them as well? I need only two.
r: Sure! It's not like I have more important things to do.
I guess I can remember to look for bones if I have some spare time.
I do have these here. Take them.

halvor_mlake_leaving.m: OK. Never mind. I'll try to find long bones elsewhere.
r: I have a feeling that we'll meet there, wherever that is.

halvor_surprise.10: Halvor asked me to bring him 5 insect wings.
halvor_surprise.15: I gave Halvor the 5 insect wings he wanted.
halvor_surprise.20: Halvor asked me to bring him 5 rat tails.
halvor_surprise.30: My rat tails weren't good enough for him. He needs more. How many does he really want?
halvor_surprise.40: I refused to bring more rat tails to Halvor. He left Crossglen.
halvor_surprise.50: I met Halvor at the foot of a mountain.
halvor_surprise.60: Halvor told me he is still looking for 5 rat tails. I agreed to help again.
halvor_surprise.65: The 5 rat tails I gave him were good enough this time.
halvor_surprise.70: Halvor asked for 4 handfuls of animal hair.
halvor_surprise.75: I gave him 4 handfuls of animal hair.
halvor_surprise.80: Halvor liked only one of my handfuls of animal hair. He asked me to bring him 3 more.
halvor_surprise.90: I gave up on finding handfuls of animal hair that suit Halvor's taste. He has left.
halvor_surprise.100: I met Halvor again. He was standing by the lakeside, near an old house, in the north.
halvor_surprise.110: Halvor was in bad shape. He asked me to give him a healing potion.
halvor_surprise.111: I gave Halvor a small healing potion.
halvor_surprise.112: I gave Halvor a healing potion.
halvor_surprise.113: I gave Halvor a powerful healing potion.
halvor_surprise.114: I gave Halvor a potion made by Lodar.
halvor_surprise.115: He was healed by the potion I gave him.
halvor_surprise.120: Halvor told me he is still looking for 3 tufts of animal hair.
halvor_surprise.125: This time, the handfuls of animal hair I gave him were soft enough.
halvor_surprise.130: Halvor wants to find two bones. He wants long ones. I'll try to find some.
halvor_surprise.135: I gave Halvor two bones, but they weren't long enough. Should I really bring him more bones?
halvor_surprise.140: Halvor left the lakeside when I refused to get him more bones.
halvor_surprise.150: Exploring the ruins of Charwood, I stumbled upon Halvor.
halvor_surprise.160: Since I last met him, he found one bone that was long enough, but he's still looking for one.
halvor_surprise.165: I found a bone that was long enough, and gave it to Halvor.
halvor_surprise.170: Halvor asked me to find 10 scales from venomscale snakes.
halvor_surprise.175: I brought Halvor the 10 venomscale scales.
halvor_surprise.180: Halvor left, asking me to pay a visit to his friend Kayla if I ever go to Stoutford.
halvor_surprise.190: I met Kayla in Stoutford. She offered me a pair of the boots she made with Halvor's items.
